title: Reading the response - status codes and error fingerprints

blocks.title: Reading the response — what each code actually means
rows: The route is genuinely not mounted — a real UI-only wall
404, with a JSON or text body
Wrong path or wrong host — keep hunting
Read-only resource. This is NOT an entitlement problem
Missing service-account role, or an unregistered connector type
Business state — a job is already running for that source
Conflicts with the current state of the resource
You hit identity-service — wrong host or plane
Invalid import package — hand-built zips are rejected
Specify a mapping ID — mttask only WRAPS an existing mapping
Native loader failure — a missing OS library

blocks.title: Add this row to the decoder ring
rows: Route is mounted at the gateway but nothing is serving behind it. NOT a success. Assert on body shape, never on status alone.
every data360 path on dmp-us (CDGC + Marketplace)

The v3 objects resource does NOT validate the type filter. q=type=='TOTALLY_FAKE_TYPE_ZZZ' returns the same clean empty result as a real type. An empty count is therefore never evidence that a feature is absent.
Verb and path both exist; you sent the wrong Content-Type. Positive evidence, same family as 400/422.
